title: 得 (děi), 必须 and 应该: "Must" and "Should" in Chinese (HSK 3)
description: 得 (děi), 必须 (bìxū) and 应该 (yīnggāi): how to say "have to", "must" and "should" in Chinese, the negatives 不用 and 不应该, and HSK 3 examples.
h1: 得, 必须 and 应该: "Must" and "Should"
lede: Chinese has three common words for what you need to do. 得 (děi) is the everyday spoken "have to". 必须 (bìxū) is a firm "must", often for rules. 应该 (yīnggāi) is "should": the right or sensible thing to do.

paras: This 得 is read děi, not de. It is the usual word in conversation when something needs to be done, often because of the time or the situation.

examples.py: Tài wǎn le, wǒ děi zǒu le.
examples.en: It's late. I've got to go.

examples.zh: 明天有考试，我今天得复习。
examples.py: Míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì, wǒ jīntiān děi fùxí.
examples.en: There's an exam tomorrow, so I have to revise today.

paras: 必须 is stronger than 得 and sounds more serious. You often see it in rules and instructions, and it is the word to use in writing.

examples.zh: 上课的时候必须关手机。
examples.py: Shàngkè de shíhou bìxū guān shǒujī.
examples.en: Phones must be switched off during lessons.
You must take your passport when you fly.

paras: 应该 gives advice or says what is right. With 不 in front, 不应该 means "shouldn't". 应该 can also mean "should" in the sense of "probably": 他应该到了 is "he should be there by now".

examples.py: Nǐ bù yīnggāi zhème wǎn shuìjiào.
examples.en: You shouldn't go to bed so late.

examples.py: Tā yīnggāi yǐjīng dào jiā le.
examples.en: He should be home by now.

paras: The most common mistake is the negative. To say "don't have to" or "don't need to", use 不用 for both 得 and 必须. 不得 does not mean "don't have to", and 不必须 is wrong. Note the tone change: 不用 is búyòng.

examples.zh: 明天是星期六，你不用去上班。
examples.py: Míngtiān shì xīngqīliù, nǐ búyòng qù shàngbān.
examples.en: Tomorrow's Saturday, so you don't have to go to work.

worksheet.title: 得, 必须 and 应该 Worksheet: HSK 3 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 得 (děi), 必须 and 应该 worksheet for HSK 3: 16 exercises (应该, 得 or 不用, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.h2: Choose 应该, 得 or 不用
exercises.instructions: Write 应该, 得 or 不用 in each gap. Does the English say "should", "have to" or "don't have to"?

items.en: You've got a cold. You should rest more.
It's Sunday, so I don't have to work.
It's nine o'clock. I've got to go.

items.zh: 你＿＿给我钱，这是我送你的。
items.en: You don't need to give me any money. It's a present.
You should go to bed a bit earlier.

items.zh: 明天早上六点的飞机，我＿＿五点起床。
items.en: My flight is at six tomorrow morning, so I have to get up at five.
It isn't cold outside. You don't need to wear so much.

items.zh: 他八点就出发了，现在＿＿到了。
items.en: He left at eight, so he should be there by now.

items.zh: 我的作业还没有做完，今天晚上＿＿做完。
items.en: I haven't finished my homework, so I've got to finish it tonight.

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence.

items.en: You don't have to come tomorrow.
I've got to go to the hospital now.

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.zh: 明天不上课，你不得去学校。
items.en: There are no lessons tomorrow, so you don't have to go to school.
answers: 明天不上课，你不用去学校。
